_comment: Looks: short style blocks added after a typed video prompt. `picks` are director's menu ids (menu.json) used when the caller picks nothing; `look`, `pacing` and `sound` are written for any model, plain and visual, without brands or on-screen text. `swatch` is three colours for the card. Keep each look under ~450 characters of words so it fits a 2000-character model with room for the prompt.

looks.title: Golden hour drama
looks.bestFor: Story moments, brand films, a character at their best.
looks.look: Warm amber highlights and soft teal-leaning shadows, gentle halation around bright edges, shallow depth of field, fine 35mm film grain.
looks.pacing: Unhurried: one continuous move that settles at the end.
looks.sound: Soft wind and a slowly swelling string pad.

looks.title: Neo-noir night
looks.bestFor: Thrillers, night city scenes, moody fashion.
looks.look: Inky blacks and deep shadows, rain-wet surfaces reflecting sodium orange and cyan signs, light haze catching every beam, horizontal anamorphic-style flares.
looks.sound: Rain patter, distant traffic and a low synth drone.

looks.title: Epic scale
looks.look: Vast landscape with atmospheric haze layering the distance, cool desaturated sky over earthy ground tones, crisp large-format clarity, the subject small against the scale.
looks.pacing: Slow and majestic, one sweeping move.
looks.sound: Deep wind and a slow orchestral swell.

looks.title: Studio hero
looks.bestFor: Packshots, launches, anything with a logo and edges.
looks.look: Seamless dark backdrop, crisp rim light tracing every edge, controlled glossy highlights, true-to-life colour, razor-sharp surface detail, nothing else in frame.
looks.pacing: Motion-control smooth, ending on a clean hero angle.
looks.sound: A soft whoosh into a low, clean hit.

looks.title: Clean tech
looks.bestFor: Devices, apps, software and health products.
looks.look: Bright white and pale grey set, soft shadowless light, minimal composition with plenty of empty space, cool neutral colour, subtle glassy reflections.
looks.pacing: Calm and exact; every move eases in and out.

looks.title: Appetite macro
looks.tagline: Steam, drips and crunch, up close.
looks.look: Warm backlight making steam, droplets and textures glow, very shallow focus, glossy real surfaces with natural imperfections, rich warm saturated colour.
looks.sound: Close sizzle, pour and crunch foley.

looks.title: Hyper promo
looks.look: Punchy saturated colour and high contrast, speed ramps from fast motion into slow motion and back, motion blur on the fastest moves, bold graphic framing.
looks.pacing: Fast and rhythmic; changes land on the beat.
looks.sound: Driving percussion with a hit on every speed ramp.

looks.title: Phone selfie
looks.bestFor: UGC ads, testimonials, talking to camera.
looks.look: Shot on a phone held at arm's length: front-camera wide lens, natural window light, small auto-exposure shifts, an ordinary lived-in background, no cinematic colour grade.
looks.pacing: Natural and spontaneous, speaking straight to the lens.
looks.sound: A clear, close voice with real room sound.

looks.title: Sunny lifestyle
looks.look: Bright warm daylight, airy colours leaning pastel, lifted soft shadows, glowing skin tones, candid in-between moments rather than poses.

looks.title: Fashion editorial
looks.tagline: Hard light, bold colour, held poses.
looks.look: High-fashion lookbook: one hard key light with crisp shadows, a bold solid-colour backdrop, clean styling, confident poses held for a beat, glossy magazine finish.
looks.pacing: Measured; each pose is held before the next.

looks.title: Intimate portrait
looks.look: Soft directional light sculpting the face, background falling off into darkness, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, muted warm palette.
looks.pacing: Very slow; let small expressions play out.
looks.sound: Quiet room tone and a single soft piano note.

looks.title: Anime cel
looks.look: 2D cel-shaded anime style: clean ink outlines, flat colour with two-tone shading, painted sky backgrounds, soft light bloom, small hand-drawn effects for wind and sparkles.

looks.title: Soft 3D toon
looks.look: Soft 3D animation: rounded stylised characters and props, gentle subsurface glow on skin, vivid saturated colour, soft global illumination, subtle squash and stretch in motion.
looks.sound: Playful orchestral cue with soft foley.

looks.title: Claymation
looks.look: Handmade stop-motion clay: visible fingerprints and texture, a miniature set with tiny props, soft studio light, slightly stepped motion at about 12 frames per second.
looks.sound: Plucked strings and soft handmade foley.

looks.title: Vintage 16mm
looks.look: 16mm film: heavy organic grain, softer edges, slight gate weave, warm faded colour with lifted blacks, an occasional warm light leak.
looks.sound: Projector hum under a soft vintage melody.

looks.title: Vérité
looks.bestFor: Behind the scenes, testimonials, true stories.
looks.look: Natural available light, true-to-life colour, slight exposure breathing, a gentle handheld sway as if the operator reacts live, light grain.
looks.pacing: Observational; the camera discovers rather than performs.
looks.sound: Natural sound and room tone only, no music.

looks.title: Retro camcorder
looks.look: 1990s camcorder footage: soft low-resolution image, colour bleeding at the edges, faint scan lines, slight tracking wobble, warm faded colour, no on-screen text.
looks.sound: Built-in camera microphone hiss and nearby voices.
